# Mythri Studio

Mythri Studio (also known as Mythri Studios or My3 Studio) is a photography studio
based in Nandyal, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## About

Founded in 2018 by lead photographer Anji, Mythri Studio provides professional
photography and videography services in Nandyal and across Andhra Pradesh.
The studio has documented over 1,000 weddings and ceremonies since establishment.

## Services

- Wedding photography (Muhurtham, Pellikoduku/Pellikooturu, Reception, pre-wedding shoots)
- Portrait photography (bridal portraits, family portraits, maternity, newborn, studio lighting)
- Event photography (birthdays, cradle ceremonies, corporate events)
- Cinematic 4K videography and wedding films
- Luxury lay-flat heirloom album design and printing
- Aerial drone photography and videography
- Kid's portrait studio (dedicated branch, specialising in milestone photography)
